job_description: Why This Role Exists We build real production systems  fintech tools, streaming services, and operations software used by real customers across several countries. Our backend is solid (.NET Core, Kafka, SQL Server), but our frontends need someone dedicated who actually cares about web development. We have a mix of new features to build and older screens (including some legacy AngularJS / older Angular) that need to be cleaned up and modernized. We don’t need buzzwords or corporate slide decks. We need a capable Angular developer who writes clean TypeScript, builds responsive pages that don’t lag, and works well with our backend team. You will report directly to the CTO. No middle managers, no endless sprint ceremonies, and no bureaucracy.   What You’ll Actually Do Build and Maintain Angular Apps Build clean, reliable web apps using  Angular and TypeScript . Structure your code properly: reusable components, well-organized services, and readable logic. Help us update and refactor older frontend code (migrating older AngularJS / early Angular screens to modern Angular) step by step without breaking live users. Connect APIs and Real-Time Data Hook up frontend screens to our backend  REST APIs . Handle real-time data using  WebSockets or SignalR  (for live dashboards and notifications). Handle edge cases properly: loading spinners, error messages, connection drops, and token refreshes so users never get stuck on a broken page. UI, Styling, and Performance Build clean, responsive layouts that work well on desktop, tablets, and phones. Write sensible  CSS / SCSS  without bloating the site. Keep pages fast: optimize bundle sizes, use lazy loading, and make sure pages feel smooth and responsive. Collaborate with the Team Work directly with our C# backend developers to decide what APIs should look like before code gets written. Review team code, test your own work before merging, and help keep bugs out of production. Talk with the CTO and team in clear  English  on daily progress.   The Tech Stack Layer What We Use Framework Angular (modern versions, plus older AngularJS screens to modernize) Language TypeScript, modern JavaScript, HTML5 State & Async RxJS, Angular Signals, Services Styling SCSS / CSS, Angular Material / Bootstrap / custom styles APIs & Real-Time REST APIs, WebSockets / SignalR Authentication JWT, OAuth2 / OpenID Connect Tooling & Git Angular CLI, npm, Git (Bitbucket) Environment Docker (basic usage), Nginx, Jira   What We’re Looking For Must-Haves 3+ years  of practical experience building web applications with  Angular  and  TypeScript . Good understanding of core Angular concepts: components, services, routing, lifecycle hooks, and dependency injection. Comfortable with  RxJS  — you know how to use common operators and how to avoid memory leaks. Solid  CSS / SCSS  skills — you can build clean, responsive layouts without fighting your stylesheet. Real experience working with REST APIs, authentication tokens (JWT), and login flows. You test your own code and check edge cases before calling a task “done”. Clear  English  (written and spoken) — we are an international team. Good attitude: you take pride in your work, speak up when something doesn’t make sense, and get things across the finish line. Nice-to-Haves Experience migrating legacy AngularJS (1.x) to modern Angular. Experience with  SignalR  or WebSockets. Experience with test tools like Jest, Jasmine, Playwright, or Cypress. Basic familiarity with Docker or working alongside .NET backends.   What This Job Is NOT Not just slicing Figma files.  You’ll be handling real state, APIs, logic, and data flow. Not a school project.  We won’t micromanage you, but you need to know how to solve problems and debug your own code. Not a bureaucracy.  There are no 5-tier approval chains to ship a bug fix.   What We Offer Benefit Details Direct Communication You work directly with the CTO and founders. Time Off 14 days annual leave + public holidays. Work Week 5-day week, Monday to Friday. Real Impact Your code goes live to real users right away. Competitive Salary Paid based on your skills and what you can deliver.

job_description: Job Description The Medical Officer – Staff Clinic & Vaccination Centre is responsible for providing comprehensive primary healthcare services to hospital employees, managing staff clinic activities, assessing employee fitness and medical leave requirements, supporting occupational health programs, and overseeing vaccination services. The position ensures that medical leave, fitness-for-duty, and work-restriction recommendations are based on appropriate clinical assessment, objective medical evidence, hospital policy, and applicable medical guidelines. Duties & Responsibilities 1. Staff Clinical Services Provide clinical consultation, examination, diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up for hospital employees presenting with illness, injury, or other medical conditions. Assess employees who present with illness or medical conditions requiring absence from duty. Review the employee’s clinical history, presenting symptoms, physical findings, relevant investigation reports, and prescribed medications before recommending medical leave. Assess whether an employee is medically unfit to perform his/her assigned duties due to illness, injury, or other medical conditions. Provide appropriate treatment, health advice, and follow-up care within the scope of professional competence. Refer employees to appropriate specialists, hospitals, diagnostic centres, or other healthcare facilities when further assessment or treatment is required. Provide immediate first aid, emergency assessment, stabilization, and referral for workplace medical emergencies. 2. Medical Leave & Sick Leave Assessment Issue appropriate  medical certificates and sick leave recommendations  in accordance with hospital policy, applicable medical guidelines, and professional standards. Determine the appropriate duration of sick leave based on the employee’s clinical condition, treatment requirements, functional limitations, and expected recovery period. Where an employee submits a prescription, medical certificate, investigation report, or other medical document issued by another doctor/hospital, review the submitted documentation and, where appropriate, clinically assess the employee before endorsing or recommending sick leave. Avoid approving or recommending sick leave solely on the basis of a prescription or external medical document without appropriate clinical assessment, particularly where the proposed duration of leave is significant, the medical condition is unclear, or functional capacity requires clarification. Verify and assess relevant medical information objectively while respecting the confidentiality and professional integrity of the treating physician and employee. Conduct follow-up or reassessment where  extended sick leave, recurrent illness, prolonged absence, or continued functional limitation  is involved. Reassess employees when clinically appropriate before recommending continuation of prolonged medical leave. Ensure that sick leave recommendations are based on  clinical necessity, objective medical assessment, and functional capacity , rather than personal preference, discrimination, or undue influence. 3. Fitness-for-Duty & Return-to-Work Assessment Provide  fitness-for-duty recommendations  when an employee is medically fit to resume assigned duties. Assess an employee’s functional ability in relation to his/her specific job responsibilities before recommending return to work, where clinically indicated. Recommend  modified duties, restricted duties, temporary work restrictions, or phased return to work  where medically appropriate. Clearly communicate relevant work restrictions while maintaining appropriate medical confidentiality. Recommend further medical evaluation or specialist assessment where fitness for duty cannot be determined adequately at the Staff Clinic. Follow up employees returning from prolonged illness, injury, hospitalization, or significant medical conditions as required. 4. Vaccination Centre Management Oversee and provide vaccination services for hospital employees in accordance with applicable immunization guidelines and hospital protocols. Assess employees for vaccination eligibility, contraindications, precautions, and relevant medical history before vaccination. Administer or supervise administration of vaccines safely and appropriately. Ensure proper  vaccine storage, cold-chain maintenance, stock monitoring, expiry control, and inventory management . Maintain accurate vaccination records and ensure appropriate documentation of vaccine type, batch/lot number, date, and relevant clinical information. Monitor employees for immediate adverse reactions following vaccination. Identify, manage, document, and report  adverse events following immunization (AEFI)  in accordance with applicable requirements. Plan and support staff vaccination campaigns, including seasonal, occupational, and outbreak-related vaccination programs. 5. Occupational & Preventive Health Support occupational health surveillance and employee health-promotion activities. Participate in pre-employment, periodic, and other medical examinations as assigned. Provide counselling regarding communicable diseases, workplace health risks, hygiene, nutrition, lifestyle, immunization, and preventive healthcare. Identify suspected occupational illnesses, communicable diseases, or workplace-related health concerns and recommend appropriate action. Support infection prevention and control initiatives within the hospital. Participate in workplace health awareness programs and emergency preparedness activities. 6. Clinic Administration & Documentation Maintain accurate, complete, and confidential records of employee consultations, medical assessments, medical certificates, sick leave recommendations, fitness assessments, vaccination records, and follow-up visits. Ensure strict confidentiality of employee medical information in accordance with professional ethics and applicable laws/policies. Monitor clinic medicines, medical supplies, equipment, and other essential resources. Ensure appropriate maintenance, calibration, and availability of medical equipment. Prepare periodic reports on clinic activities, employee consultations, medical leave, fitness assessments, vaccinations, and other relevant indicators. Maintain appropriate documentation for audit, quality assurance, occupational health, and regulatory purposes. 7. Key Duties & Responsibilities Provide  clinical consultation, examination, diagnosis, and treatment  for employees presenting to the staff clinic. Manage common acute and chronic medical conditions and provide appropriate follow-up care. Assess medical emergencies and provide  first aid, stabilization, and emergency management  before referral when required. Refer patients to hospitals, specialists, diagnostic centres, or other healthcare facilities when necessary. Conduct routine health assessments and advise employees on preventive and promotive healthcare. Maintain accurate and confidential  patient medical records, prescriptions, clinical notes, and referral documentation . Manage the day-to-day clinical operations of the staff clinic and ensure availability of essential medicines, equipment, and medical supplies. Oversee the  vaccination centre , including vaccine administration, screening, consent, documentation, and post-vaccination observation. Ensure proper  vaccine storage, cold-chain management, stock monitoring, expiry control, and inventory records  in accordance with applicable guidelines. Develop and implement employee vaccination programs, including routine, seasonal, occupational, and campaign-based vaccination. Monitor and document  adverse events following immunization (AEFI)  and ensure appropriate medical management and reporting. Provide health counselling on  immunization, hygiene, nutrition, lifestyle, communicable diseases, and occupational health risks . Support workplace health-promotion activities, medical awareness programs, and employee wellness initiatives. Participate in  occupational health surveillance , pre-employment/periodic medical examinations, and fitness assessments as assigned. Identify and report suspected  communicable diseases or occupational illnesses  according to organizational policy and applicable regulations. Coordinate with HR, Administration, HSE/Occupational Health teams, laboratories, hospitals, and external healthcare providers. Ensure compliance with  infection prevention and control, biomedical waste management, medical ethics, and patient confidentiality  requirements. Supervise and guide nurses, paramedics, vaccinators, and other clinic staff as applicable. Monitor clinic performance, patient statistics, vaccination coverage, medicine consumption, and other relevant healthcare indicators. Prepare periodic  medical, vaccination, inventory, and occupational-health reports  for management. Ensure medical equipment is properly maintained, calibrated, and readily available for clinical use. Participate in emergency preparedness activities, including workplace medical response and emergency drills. Stay updated on relevant  clinical guidelines, vaccination recommendations, occupational-health standards, and regulatory requirements . 7গ ইন

job_description: Job Context DTech Corporation Limited is seeking resourceful and detail-oriented professionals to support management with daily administration, business correspondence, commercial documentation, accounts coordination, and digital content creation. Candidates must have strong practical skills in AI tools and Microsoft Office, with the ability to transform verbal instructions, rough notes, and business information into professional documents, presentations, and marketing materials. The position also involves bank visits and outside-office coordination as required. Job Responsibilities Support management with daily administrative activities, scheduling, meeting arrangements, minutes, records, and follow-ups. Draft and refine professional emails, letters, proposals, reports, and correspondence with clients, suppliers, banks, and business partners. Convert Bangla and English verbal instructions, voice messages, and rough notes into clear, professional business communication. Use ChatGPT and other AI tools for drafting, editing, translation, summarization, research, and document preparation. Assist with LC application drafts, amendment requests, and import-related correspondence based on approved commercial terms, for review by the commercial or finance team. Visit banks to submit and collect documents, deposit cheques, obtain statements and acknowledgements, and follow up on authorized banking matters. Assist the accounts department with administrative paperwork, bill and voucher organization, expense records, reimbursement documents, and payment supporting documents. Coordinate with accounts and commercial teams to collect missing invoices, receipts, challans, and other required documents. Maintain trackers for bills, payment requests, document submissions, and pending approvals; follow up with the relevant departments. Coordinate office purchases, stationery, supplies, couriers, printing, and routine service requirements. Communicate with vendors and service providers, collect quotations, and prepare comparison sheets for management review. Visit client, supplier, and other offices to submit or collect documents and complete assigned administrative tasks. Prepare and format letters, reports, tables, and reusable templates in Microsoft Word. Maintain Excel records, task trackers, comparison sheets, and summaries using formulas, PivotTables, and charts as required. Create professional PowerPoint presentations, company profiles, and project or marketing proposals. The candidate should have enough experience to generate any text and photos to ChatGPT/Claude or any given AI. Generate and edit images using AI tools for social media, promotional materials, and marketing campaigns. Prepare social media captions, basic designs, and marketing content using Canva or similar tools. Organize digital and physical files, maintain document versions, and prepare documents in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF formats. Develop reusable AI prompts and document templates to improve the speed and consistency of routine work. Verify AI-generated content for factual accuracy, language, figures, and formatting before submitting it for approval. Maintain confidentiality of company, client, banking, and financial information. Obtain necessary approval before issuing external correspondence, publishing content, or processing transactions. Perform other administrative and coordination duties assigned by management.

job_description: About DTech Corporation Limited DTech Corporation Limited is one of Bangladesh’s largest and most established façade engineering, fabrication, and installation companies. With over 30 years of industry experience and more than 300 successfully completed projects, DTech has built a strong reputation for delivering high-quality and innovative façade solutions for commercial, residential, industrial, institutional, and government developments. Our expertise includes curtain wall systems, structural glazing, ACP cladding, aluminum doors and windows, skylights, glass domes, canopies, spider glazing, architectural metalwork, and customized building-envelope solutions. Job Context DTech Corporation Limited is seeking a highly experienced and technically capable Senior Project Manager (Façade/Structural Engineering) to lead multiple projects from system design and structural analysis through procurement, fabrication, installation, quality assurance, and final handover. The successful candidate will oversee project teams, vendors, subcontractors, labor deployment, and quality-control activities across the company’s projects. The role also includes RCC and steel structural design, technical problem-solving, and coordination with HR on project personnel matters. Extensive practical experience in the façade industry and valid membership of the Institution of Engineers, Bangladesh (IEB) are mandatory. Job Location:  Banani, Dhaka, with regular visits to project sites Workplace : Office and project sites Job Responsibilities Project Leadership, Planning and Coordination Lead and support Project Engineers, site engineers, supervisors, and project teams in planning, executing, monitoring, and completing multiple projects. Prepare and monitor project schedules, work programs, budgets, procurement schedules, manpower plans, and resource allocations. Coordinate with clients, consultants, architects, structural engineers, main contractors, subcontractors, and internal departments. Conduct project meetings, site inspections, progress reviews, and technical coordination meetings. Review progress reports, technical submissions, method statements, meeting minutes, variation documents, and handover records. Identify project risks, delays, technical challenges, and resource shortages; implement corrective measures and report critical issues to management. Ensure projects meet approved timelines, budgets, specifications, quality standards, and safety requirements. Façade System Design and Technical Development Independently design, develop, detail, and coordinate the following systems: Stick, semi-unitized, and unitized curtain wall systems. General sliding, Euro sliding, folding, and bifold door systems. Structural glazing and spider glazing systems. ACP cladding, louvers, and architectural metalwork. Aluminum doors and windows. Glass canopies, glass domes, and skylights. Customized façade and building-envelope systems. Responsibilities include: Develop façade system concepts, technical details, connection details, and fixing methodologies. Prepare and review shop drawings, fabrication drawings, cutting lists, installation drawings, and as-built drawings. Review architectural, structural, and MEP drawings to identify interfaces, resolve clashes, and coordinate design requirements. Prepare material take-offs, BOQs, technical specifications, and engineering documentation. Coordinate design submissions, technical clarifications, and approvals with clients and consultants. Evaluate wind resistance, deflection, water tightness, air tightness, thermal movement, and structural stability. Resolve design issues arising during procurement, fabrication, and installation. Structural Analysis and Design Perform and oversee structural analysis and design of façade elements, including mullions, transoms, glass panels, brackets, anchors, fasteners, support frames, and connections. Determine appropriate glass thicknesses and check component stress, deflection, load transfer, and structural adequacy. Carry out RCC structural design for beams, slabs, columns, retaining walls, and foundations as required. Design steel frames, trusses, platforms, façade supports, and customized metal structures. Calculate wind, dead, live, seismic, and other applicable loads and load combinations. Prepare, review, and verify structural calculation reports, load schedules, structural drawings, and engineering reports for consultant approval. Apply BNBC 2020 and relevant ACI, BS, Eurocode, and ASTM requirements, as applicable to the design, materials, testing, and project specifications. Coordinate with structural consultants and testing agencies, conduct structural safety checks, and provide timely solutions to site engineering problems. Vendor, Procurement and Commercial Coordination Identify, evaluate, select, and manage local and international vendors, suppliers, fabricators, and subcontractors in accordance with company approval procedures. Obtain and compare technical and commercial quotations; negotiate pricing, delivery schedules, payment terms, warranties, and technical requirements. job_description: BKY JUTE MILLS LTD. 100% Export-Oriented Japanese Manufacturing Company Job Title:  Quality Control Officer Department:  Quality Control / Quality Assurance Employment Status:  Full-time Job Location:  Kolabaria, Choto Darogar Hat-4311, Sitakunda, Chattogram, Bangladesh Vacancy:  Not Specified Salary:  Negotiable Experience:  3–5 Years About BKY JUTE MILLS LTD. BKY JUTE MILLS LTD.  is a  100% export-oriented Japanese manufacturing company  located in Sitakunda, Chattogram, Bangladesh, and a subsidiary of  Japan-based Marusan Sangyo Co., Ltd. We manufacture and export jute products to  high-value, quality-conscious international customers . Therefore, maintaining consistent product quality, meeting customer specifications, and ensuring international quality standards are critical to our operations. We are looking for a  competent and quality-focused Quality Control Officer  to ensure and continuously improve the quality of our  raw materials, production processes, and finished products . Job Responsibilities Raw Material Inspection: Inspect incoming raw jute fibers to ensure they meet the grade, moisture content, and quality requirements. Process Monitoring: Supervise and monitor different stages of jute processing (batching, preparing, spinning, weaving, and finishing) to maintain consistent quality. Laboratory Testing: Conduct routine lab tests (such as moisture test, tensile strength, yarn count, and twist) and maintain accurate test logs. Defect Identification: Identify production defects, deviations, or contamination in jute yarn, twine, sacking, or hessian cloth, and take immediate corrective actions. Compliance Standards: Ensure all finished products strictly comply with national and international quality standards (such as ISO, BSTI, or specific buyer requirements). Reporting & Documentation: Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly quality control reports, rejection logs, and inspection certificates. Wastage Reduction: Minimize production wastage and optimize efficiency by analyzing quality-related issues and suggesting process improvements. Team Coordination: Collaborate with the production floor managers, supervisors, and floor workers to implement quality management policies. Equipment Calibration: Ensure all laboratory and measuring instruments are properly calibrated, maintained, and clean. Educational Requirements Education:  B.Sc. in  Textile Engineering / Jute Technology / Chemistry or a related discipline  from a reputed/recognized university. Preference:  Candidates with an academic background in  Jute and Allied Fiber Process Engineering  will be given preference. Candidates having a strong academic or practical background in  jute fibre, yarn, spinning, weaving, textile testing, or quality control  will be highly preferred. Experience Requirements 3–5 years  of relevant experience in  Quality Control / Quality Assurance , preferably in a  Jute Mill or related manufacturing industry . Candidates with hands-on experience in  jute product inspection, laboratory testing, process quality control, defect analysis, or export-quality assurance  will be preferred. Required Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of  jute fibre grading, preparation, spinning, yarn quality, weaving, and finished product inspection . Good understanding of  quality testing methods and laboratory practices . Ability to identify defects and analyze their root causes. Strong analytical and problem-solving ability. Excellent attention to detail and a strong sense of responsibility for product quality. Ability to read and understand  technical specifications and customer quality requirements . Good knowledge of  quality documentation, reporting, and record keeping . Proficiency in  MS Office, particularly Excel , for quality data analysis and reporting. Ability to work independently as well as coordinate effectively with Production and other departments. Communication Requirements Good communication and reporting skills in  both Bengali and English . Ability to communicate quality requirements effectively with production-floor personnel and management. Ability to prepare quality reports and communicate quality issues in English where required for international customers/management. Additional Requirements Age:  25–35 years The candidate should be physically and mentally capable of working in a  manufacturing/production environment  and conducting regular production-floor inspections. Willingness to work closely with production team. Strong integrity, discipline, responsibility, and commitment to maintaining product quality. Compensation & Other Benefits Salary:  Negotiable , depending on qualifications and experience. Other benefits:  As per Company Policy and applicable laws of Bangladesh.
